title: xDrip+ does not vibrate when phone is on silent mode, but alert is set to override silent.
symptom: When the phone is in Do Not Disturb mode (silent), xDrip alerts set to vibrate only or ascending volume do not vibrate, while Low, Medium, or High profiles make sound even in silent mode but do not vibrate.
cause: The issue is related to Android's Do Not Disturb feature, specifically 'Total Silence' mode, where the 'override silent mode' option does not work.
fix: No definitive fix was provided; the issue was closed as no longer relevant. Testing showed that 'override silent mode' works in 'Priority Only' and 'Alarms Only' modes but not in 'Total Silence'.
evidence_quote: The only one it doesn't work in is `Total Silence`.
